charges.description: WHILE ON DUTY, DID USE UNNECESSARY PHYSICAL FORCE AGAINST  A PERSON KNOWN TO THE DEPARTMENT WITHOUT POLICE NECESSITY.
charges.penalty: DISMISSAL PROBATION (12 month(s) ), SUSPENDED W/O PAY (5 day(s) ), VACATION DAYS (35 day(s) )

charges.description: while on-duty, wrongfully used force to a person known to the Department.
charges.penalty: DISMISSAL PROBATION (12 month(s) ), VACATION DAYS (30 day(s) )

charges.description: while on duty, wrongfully failed to document force accurately on a Threat, Resistance or Injury (T.R.I.) Incident worksheet, as required.
charges.penalty: DISMISSAL PROBATION (12 month(s) ), VACATION DAYS (30 day(s) )
